basic_details.short_information: PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya Painavu Idukki (KVS Painavu Idukki) is recruiting candidates for Primary Teacher, Vocational Instructor, and Counsellor posts on a part-time contractual basis. Qualifications for these positions vary by post, and candidates must possess proficiency to teach in Hindi & English medium along with compulsory working knowledge in computer. Eligible applicants must submit their online application through the KVS Samvida Sathi portal on or before 15 October 2026 at 5:00 PM. content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The official notification does not state the exact number of vacancies available for each post. The institution is conducting a walk-in interview to draw panels of part-time contractual teachers and staff for the following positions: Primary Teacher Vocational Instructor Counsellor

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Desirable Qualification for Vocational Instructor: Proficiency in teaching in Hindi and English.

rows.essential_qualification_required: Senior Secondary (or its equivalent) with at least 50% marks and 2 years Diploma in Elementary Education (or its equivalent); OR Senior Secondary with at least 50% marks and 4 year Bachelor of Elementary Education (B.El.Ed); OR Senior Secondary with at least 50% marks and 2 years Diploma in Education. CTET Part 1 qualified candidates. Proficiency to teach in Hindi & English medium. Working knowledge in computer is compulsory.
B.E, B.Tech / M.Tech (Electronic & Communication Engineering) with minimum one year experience.

BA/B.Sc. in Psychology with a certificate or diploma in counseling, and minimum 1 year experience providing career/educational counselling to students at schools; OR working knowledge and experience in placement bureaus; OR registration with rehabilitation council of India as vocational counsellor.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for KVS Painavu Idukki Primary Teacher
content_sections.text: Visit the KVS Samvida Sathi portal. Submit your application online before 5:00 PM on 15 October 2026. Report to the Vidyalaya for the walk-in interview on 16 October 2026 at 9:00 AM.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection for the contractual panels will be conducted through a walk-in interview held at the Vidyalaya on 16 October 2026, with a reporting time of 9:00 a.m. Candidates must apply online via the KVS Samvida Sathi portal prior to the deadline.

faq.question: Q1. Is this a permanent job or on contract?
faq.answer: These positions are offered on a part-time contractual basis to form a panel of teachers and staff.

faq.question: Q2. Who gets a relaxation in marks or qualifications?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify any relaxations in marks or qualifications for specific categories.

faq.question: Q3. What are the desirable qualifications for the Vocational Instructor post?
faq.answer: Proficiency in teaching in Hindi and English is listed as the desirable qualification for Vocational Instructors.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The last date to apply through the KVS Samvida Sathi portal is 15 October 2026 before 5:00 PM.
